entries.title: Timon 0.1.7
entries.note: Added Plugins can draw their menu entry with the product's own ( NavLink from @timon/ui ), so it folds with the side menu instead of squeezing its label into it. When accounts beyond the first superadmin are suspended (no pro licence, or no Multi-user plugin), the superadmin gets a card saying why; their data are kept. Signed plugins can now manage a team's accounts: add accounts and open their sessions ( accounts:provision ), say which rights each account holds ( accounts:permissions-source ), and serve pages without a session such as an invitation ( http:public ). The account provider also reads and updates the accounts it serves, writes the audit log, and reads the catalogue of rights a role can grant. Plugins can keep their data in a SQLite database of their own ( ctx.sql , permission storage:sql ), with migrations declared in their manifest and applied when they start. The Git widge
